description: TwelveMonkeys common-lang provides low-level language and utility extensions for Java, including string, date, reflection, and bean-property helpers (StringUtil, DateUtil, ReflectUtil, BeanUtil, Validate) plus specialized collections such as LRU, timeout, and case-insensitive maps and a pluggable type-conversion framework. It underpins the other TwelveMonkeys common and ImageIO modules by supplying shared, dependency-free building blocks used throughout the library.
